name: agent-confirm-sound
description: Sound + OS notification the moment your AI agent needs attention — Claude Code, aider, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and any terminal agent. Alert history, reminder escalation, and Claude Code hook integration.

agentConfirmSound.enabled.description: Enable watching terminals for confirmation prompts.

agentConfirmSound.alertOn.description: When to fire alerts. 'confirmation' = agent waiting for y/n or approval (pattern match). 'completion' = command or agent turn finished (command-end + Claude Code Stop hook). Use 'Notification Bell: Configure Alert Triggers' from the Command Palette for an easier picker.

agentConfirmSound.patterns.description: Case-insensitive regex patterns matched against terminal output. A sound plays on the first match (then debounces). Tune these for the agents you use — check the output channel to see what's actually coming through. Tip: enable debugLog to inspect raw terminal chunks.

agentConfirmSound.terminalNameFilter.description: Optional. If non-empty, only terminals whose name contains one of these strings (case-insensitive) are watched. Leave empty to watch all terminals. Example: ["claude", "aider"]

agentConfirmSound.debounceMs.description: Minimum time in milliseconds between sounds for the same terminal, to avoid repeated triggers on the same prompt.

agentConfirmSound.volume.description: Volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full) to 2 (200% amplification). Applied via afplay -v (macOS), paplay --volume (Linux), and WAV sample scaling (Windows). Values above 1.0 digitally amplify — may clip very loud source files. Only 16-bit PCM WAV supports scaling on Windows; MP3/OGG play via WPF MediaPlayer.

agentConfirmSound.focusTerminal.description: When a pattern matches, bring the matching terminal into focus automatically.

agentConfirmSound.alertOnCommandEnd.description: Play a sound when any terminal command finishes (respects commandEndMinDurationMs). Useful for long-running builds, tests, or deploys — you'll hear the bell when they're done.

agentConfirmSound.commandEndMinDurationM.description: Minimum command duration in milliseconds before alertOnCommandEnd fires. Default 3000ms (3s) — quick commands like ls or cd are ignored, only long-running ones trigger the alert.

agentConfirmSound.osNotification.description: Show an OS-level notification (Windows balloon tip / macOS notification center / Linux notify-send) when an alert fires and VS Code is not in focus. Lets you know something needs attention even when you're on another screen.

agentConfirmSound.hookPreToolUse.description: Also install a PreToolUse(Bash) Claude Code hook that fires before every bash command. Useful if you run Claude with manual bash approval (requiresApproval). Leave off if bash is auto-approved — every command would trigger a sound.

agentConfirmSound.reminderIntervalMs.description: If non-zero, re-alert after this many milliseconds if the agent is still waiting. 0 = disabled. Example: 120000 for a 2-minute reminder. Cancelled automatically when you run a new command in the waiting terminal.

agentConfirmSound.reminderMaxCount.description: Maximum number of reminders to fire before stopping. Only applies when reminderIntervalMs > 0.

agentConfirmSound.muteWhenFocused.description: Suppress alert sounds when VS Code is the active foreground window. Status bar flash and history recording still happen — only the sound is skipped. Useful in quiet environments where you are actively watching the terminal.

agentConfirmSound.focusMode.description: Hide OS popup notifications (Windows balloon tip, macOS notification banner, Linux notify-send) while keeping the alert sound. Useful when you can hear the bell but don't want notification popups cluttering your screen.

agentConfirmSound.debugLog.description: Log every terminal chunk to the output channel (after ANSI stripping). Use this to see exactly what text reaches Agent Bell and tune your patterns. Disable when done — it is verbose.

agentConfirmSound.sounds.description: List of absolute paths to sound files (.wav/.mp3/.aiff/.ogg/.flac). Leave empty to use the bundled sound. Add multiple files and set soundMode to 'random' to rotate through them. Use 'Notification Bell: Manage Sounds' from the Command Palette for an easier UI.

enumDescriptions: Always use the first sound in the list.
Pick a sound at random from the list each time.
agentConfirmSound.soundMode.description: How to pick a sound when multiple are configured. 'fixed' uses the first, 'random' picks one at random.

scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && npx vsce package --out dist/
